entries.en: Pro users now have access to Opus 4.5 as part of their subscription!
entries.zh: Pro 用户现在可以把 Opus 4.5 作为订阅的一部分使用！

entries.en: Windows: Managed settings now prefer `C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode` if it exists. Support for `C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode` will be removed in a future version.
entries.zh: Windows：如果 `C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode` 存在，托管设置现在优先使用它。`C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode` 的支持将在未来版本中移除。

entries.en: Fixed timer duration showing "11m 60s" instead of "12m 0s"
entries.zh: 修复计时器时长显示为"11m 60s"而非"12m 0s"的问题
